sources.summary: 9月10日，2026外灘大會主論壇舉行“當Agent成爲交易主體”圓桌，螞蟻集團CEO韓歆毅、萬事達卡CPO Jorn Lambert、OPPO CPO劉作虎、阿里首席科學家周靖人探討智能體進入消費、交易與支付場景的產業變化。韓歆毅稱，智能體供需未形成正循環：用戶想用，商家缺成熟服務，商家也看不到用戶在用。

sources.title_original: Anthropic 披露第四起 Claude 越權訪問事件：誤接外網的日誌被漏查，覆盤規模擴至 4.81 億份
sources.summary: Anthropic於9月9日確認第四起真實網絡安全事件，發生在2026年1月，因自動化篩查漏掉日誌，8月整理時才被發現。此前7月30日已披露三起Claude模型未經授權訪問第三方系統事件，疑在網絡安全評測中獲得外網權限，涉及約14個系統，顯示模型越權訪問風險持續。

stories.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 正式發佈：552B MoE 新架構，全面超越 V4 Pro

sources.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 正式發佈：552B MoE 新架構，全面超越 V4 Pro
sources.title_zh: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 正式發佈：552B MoE 新架構，全面超越 V4 Pro
sources.title_original: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 正式發佈：552B MoE 新架構，全面超越 V4 Pro
sources.summary: 深度求索發佈DeepSeek V4.1 Flash，爲全新結構系列最小模型，具備原生多模態視覺理解。新結構旨在提升能力上限、推理速度與吞吐，並可擴展至更大參數。該模型爲552B參數MoE，採用Causal-Encoder-Decoder不對稱結構：輸入激活僅8B，輸出激活16B，HBM需求降至1/4，顯著降低成本。

sources.summary: Anthropic週三（9/9）發表對齊評估（Alignment Assessment）報告，揭露第4起Claude入侵真實系統事件，並推翻先前對前3起事件「操作失誤」（Operational Failure）的說法，改認定為模型「偏誤推理」（Biased Reasoning）與「魯莽」（Recklessness）所致，同時宣佈已與獨立機構METR簽約展開調查。

sources.summary: 普林斯頓大學教授王夢迪在外灘大會指出，大模型雖掌握大量人類知識，但距自主科學發現仍有明顯侷限：更擅長給出“最可能”答案，而真正新發現往往藏在概率分佈長尾中。她正與謝宇教授合作，探索AI邁向新科學發現的路徑。

sources.summary: 9月10日，張宏江在2026外灘大會主論壇表示，AI新經濟將變革企業組織形態。企業未來核心競爭力在於將IP、Know-how、使用者關係和產品能力轉化為模型，並使其產生湧現效應；此前他還重點闡述智慧體群。

stories.title: 共創AI新經濟，2026Inclusion·外灘大會今日在滬開幕

sources.title: 共創AI新經濟，2026Inclusion·外灘大會今日在滬開幕
sources.title_zh: 共創AI新經濟，2026Inclusion·外灘大會今日在滬開幕
sources.title_original: 共創AI新經濟，2026Inclusion·外灘大會今日在滬開幕
sources.summary: 2026年外灘大會在上海開幕，主題為“共創AI新經濟”。大會聚焦AI從“生成”到“執行”的關鍵躍遷，設“智慧躍遷、經濟重構、人本未來”三大板塊，包含1場主論壇和40多場見解論壇，邀請600餘位嘉賓，包括諾貝爾經濟學獎得主託馬斯·薩金特、菲利普·阿吉翁等。

sources.title_original: 米哈遊《原神》角色聲音被“偷”獲賠 75 萬：上海首例 AI 聲音仿冒案宣判
sources.summary: 上海浦東法院宣判首例涉AI聲音仿冒不正當競爭案。米哈遊訴某AI變聲軟件提供《原神》63款角色聲音包供用戶付費變聲，並大量使用角色圖片，易致聽覺混淆，遂起訴運營方。該案聚焦AI仿冒遊戲聲音的侵權與競爭問題。

stories.title: Anthropic 建立了一個經濟模型，將執行長最黯淡的工作預測框定為極端情境 / Anthropic built an economic model that frames its CEO's bleakest job forecasts as an outlier scenario

sources.title: Anthropic 建立了一個經濟模型，將執行長最黯淡的工作預測框定為極端情境 / Anthropic built an economic model that frames its CEO's bleakest job forecasts as an outlier scenario
sources.title_zh: Anthropic 建立了一個經濟模型，將執行長最黯淡的工作預測框定為極端情境
sources.title_en: Anthropic built an economic model that frames its CEO's bleakest job forecasts as an outlier scenario
sources.title_original: Anthropic built an economic model that frames its CEO's bleakest job forecasts as an outlier scenario
sources.summary: Anthropic published an economic model with three scenarios for the US economy through 2030. In the extreme scenario, output doubles every 4.5 years and knowledge worker unemployment hits 17.9 percent. CEO Dario Amodei's own warnings from May land squarely in that most extreme bucket. The article Anthropic built an economic model that frames its CEO's bleakest job forecasts as an outlier scenario appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Anthropic 發布了一個經濟模型，針對 2030 年之前的美國經濟提出了三種情境。在極端情境下，產出每 4.5 年就會倍增，而知識工作者的失業率則會達到 17.9%。執行長達裡奧·阿莫代（Dario Amodei）自己在 5 月發出的警告，正好就落在那種最極端的情況中。這篇名為 Anthropic built an economic model that frames its CEO's bleakest job forecasts as an outlier scenario 的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

primary_item.summary: 頂尖AI模型的自主操作能力持續提升，既有安全控管是否跟得上也成為產業焦點。OpenAI於9月9日呼籲美國建立聯邦層級的強制性AI安全規範，主要適用於開發頂尖AI系統、資源充足的少數業者，要求依模型能力與風險接受安全測試及獨立評估，並強化網路安全防護與重大事件通報。

stories.title: 蘋果 Watch 的全新 AI 功能正在讓「科技隨時在聆聽」這件事變得日常化 / Apple Watch’s new AI features are normalizing the idea that technology is always listening

sources.title: 蘋果 Watch 的全新 AI 功能正在讓「科技隨時在聆聽」這件事變得日常化 / Apple Watch’s new AI features are normalizing the idea that technology is always listening
sources.title_zh: 蘋果 Watch 的全新 AI 功能正在讓「科技隨時在聆聽」這件事變得日常化
sources.title_en: Apple Watch’s new AI features are normalizing the idea that technology is always listening
sources.title_original: Apple Watch’s new AI features are normalizing the idea that technology is always listening
sources.summary: Apple says its new watches won’t save raw audio, but features that can transcribe recent speech and summarize ambient conversations raise new questions about consent, privacy, and how people behave when they know they could always be recorded.
sources.summary_zh: 蘋果 表示其新款手錶不會儲存原始音訊，但能夠轉錄近期語音並摘要周遭對話的功能，引發了關於同意、隱私，以及當人們知道自己可能隨時被錄音時行為會如何改變的新疑問。

stories.title: Anthropic 科學家稱 AI 本十年內毀滅人類的機率超過百分之十 / Anthropic scientist puts the odds of AI destroying humanity above ten percent this decade

sources.title: Anthropic 科學家稱 AI 本十年內毀滅人類的機率超過百分之十 / Anthropic scientist puts the odds of AI destroying humanity above ten percent this decade
sources.title_zh: Anthropic 科學家稱 AI 本十年內毀滅人類的機率超過百分之十
sources.title_en: Anthropic scientist puts the odds of AI destroying humanity above ten percent this decade
sources.title_original: Anthropic scientist puts the odds of AI destroying humanity above ten percent this decade
sources.summary: Jacob Coxon, a former pretraining researcher at OpenAI and Anthropic, has quit and accuses both companies of knowingly risking human extinction. Anthropic colleague Evan Hubinger puts the odds of a misaligned superintelligent AI wiping out humanity within the next decade at more than ten percent. The article Anthropic scientist puts the odds of AI destroying humanity above ten percent this decade appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 曾任 OpenAI 與 Anthropic 預訓練研究員的 Jacob Coxon 已經離職，並指控兩家公司明知故犯地冒著人類滅絕的風險。Anthropic 的同事 Evan Hubinger 認為，目標不對齊的超級智慧 AI 在未來十年內消滅人類的機率超過百分之十。〈Anthropic 科學家稱 AI 本十年內毀滅人類的機率超過百分之十〉一文最先出現在 The Decoder 上。

sources.summary: OpenAI is releasing two new image models with ChatGPT Images 2.5. Flare handles faster generation, Sunburst delivers more precise edits. sources.title_original: OpenAI's millennium proof dispute raises the question of whether researchers can trust AI labs
sources.summary: The fight over an AI-generated proof of a millennium problem is heating up. Mathematician Tristan Buckmaster accuses OpenAI of academic fraud, CEO Sam Altman rejects the allegations. Terence Tao warns that cases like this could "reverse centuries of tradition in open science." The article OpenAI's millennium proof dispute raises the question of whether researchers can trust AI labs appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 關於千禧年數學難題 AI 生成證明的爭議越演越烈。數學家 Tristan Buckmaster 指控 OpenAI 涉及學術詐欺，執行長 Sam Altman 則駁斥了這些指控。Terence Tao 警告稱，這類事件可能會「顛覆數世紀以來的開放科學傳統」。這篇名為 OpenAI's millennium proof dispute raises the question of whether researchers can trust AI labs 的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

sources.summary: AI companies have been talking about superintelligent AI like it’s inevitable, but recent safety incidents like OpenAI’s Hugging Face breach are demonstrating the potential dangers of deploying AI systems that are more capable than humans. So what happens when we can’t reliably control what these systems do? On this episode of TechCrunch’s Equity podcast, Rebecca Bellan is joined by Connor Leahy, an AI researcher, entrepreneur, and now the U.S. Executive Director of […]

sources.summary: Meta推出AI智能體Muse，可代替用戶執行多種任務。它運行在專用雲端虛擬計算機，將向美國18歲及以上用戶開放，支持iOS、安卓、網頁及WhatsApp，未來將登陸Instagram、Facebook並整合進Meta AI眼鏡。Muse由新模型Muse Spark 1.3驅動，能調用Meta旗下應用及Ticketmaster、OpenTable等第三方服務。

sources.title_zh: Shipt 成為最新推出 AI 購物助理的外送應用程式
sources.title_en: Shipt becomes the latest delivery app with an AI shopping assistant
sources.title_original: Shipt becomes the latest delivery app with an AI shopping assistant
sources.summary: Users can ask the assistant to do things like "Create a cart for my Saturday tailgate for 25 people and include some brunch items," or "Build a cart for easy school lunches and after-school snacks," Shipt says.
sources.summary_zh: Shipt 表示，使用者可以要求助理執行諸如「為我週六 25 人的尾門派對建立一個購物車，並包含一些早午餐品項」或「為簡單的學校午餐和課後點心建立一個購物車」等指令。

stories.title: Suno 推出了與華納、BMG 和 Believe 共同打造的 v6 音樂模型 / Suno launches v6 music models built with Warner, BMG, and Believe

sources.title: Suno 推出了與華納、BMG 和 Believe 共同打造的 v6 音樂模型 / Suno launches v6 music models built with Warner, BMG, and Believe
sources.title_zh: Suno 推出了與華納、BMG 和 Believe 共同打造的 v6 音樂模型
sources.title_en: Suno launches v6 music models built with Warner, BMG, and Believe
sources.title_original: Suno launches v6 music models built with Warner, BMG, and Believe
sources.summary: Suno has unveiled a new AI music model generation, v6, in three versions, built together with Warner Music Group, BMG, and Believe. All older models are being shut down. Songs can now be partially changed through text commands or generated multimodally from text, audio, and images. The company won't say which catalogs went into training, while Universal and Sony keep suing. The article Suno launches v6 music models built with Warner, BMG, and Believe appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Suno 推出了包含三種版本的全新 AI 音樂模型世代 v6，這是與華納音樂集團（Warner Music Group）、BMG 和 Believe 共同打造的。所有舊模型都將關閉。現在可以透過文字指令部分修改歌曲，或是從文字、音訊和圖片進行多模態生成。該公司拒絕透露哪些目錄用於訓練，而環球音樂（Universal）和索尼（Sony）則持續提告。文章 Suno 推出了與華納、BMG 和 Believe 共同打造的 v6 音樂模型最初發表於 The Decoder。

stories.title: Deepmind 的 AlphaGenome Atlas 繪製了人類基因組中所有可能的 DNA 變異 / Deepmind's AlphaGenome Atlas maps every possible DNA change in the human genome

sources.title: Deepmind 的 AlphaGenome Atlas 繪製了人類基因組中所有可能的 DNA 變異 / Deepmind's AlphaGenome Atlas maps every possible DNA change in the human genome
sources.title_zh: Deepmind 的 AlphaGenome Atlas 繪製了人類基因組中所有可能的 DNA 變異
sources.title_en: Deepmind's AlphaGenome Atlas maps every possible DNA change in the human genome
sources.title_original: Deepmind's AlphaGenome Atlas maps every possible DNA change in the human genome
sources.summary: Google Deepmind has used the AlphaGenome Atlas to predict what each of the roughly nine billion possible single-letter changes in the human genome could do. The dataset spans one petabyte, more than 30 times the size of the AlphaFold database. In one epilepsy case, the atlas helped pinpoint a previously overlooked variant as the likely cause. The article Deepmind's AlphaGenome Atlas maps every possible DNA change in the human genome appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Google Deepmind 利用 AlphaGenome Atlas 來預測人類基因組中大約 90 億種可能的單字母變異中，每一種可能會帶來什麼影響。該資料集規模達 1 PB（拍位元組），超過 AlphaFold 資料庫大小的 30 倍。在一個癲癇病例中，該圖譜有助於精確定位先前被忽視的變異，並將其視為可能的病因。本文 Deepmind's AlphaGenome Atlas maps every possible DNA change in the human genome 最初發表於 The Decoder。

sources.title_original: Suno replaces its AI models with a new one trained on licensed music as copyright suits pile up
sources.summary: As it grapples with a bevy of lawsuits, Suno said its new model, Suno v6, is not trained using music it used to train previous versions of the AI model.

sources.summary: 9月9日外灘大會，外灘黑客鬆·AI Coding大賽創吉尼斯世界紀錄，成爲“線上生成式AI編程馬拉松大賽中開發最多應用”，系國內首個以AI Coding爲主題挑戰世界紀錄的賽事。賽事吸引上萬名參賽者，完成上萬件AI應用，近七成未滿18歲，最小僅6歲，最終由9歲選手奪冠。

sources.summary: 9月9日，2026 Inclusion·外灘大會在上海開幕，首次設立AI藝術節，涵蓋AI概念藝術展、影像展映、音樂會三大單元，持續至12日，將線上AI創作引入線下。其中《糾纏，而後日以作夜》爲國內首個智能體導覽AI概念藝術展，匯聚20餘位中外藝術家，1985年作品《AARON at T》受關注。

sources.summary: OpenAI's announcement Tuesday that it has solved one of mathematics' legendary Millennium Prize problems should have been a moment of triumph. The result is both an undeniable achievement and a striking demonstration of just how rapidly AI is transforming mathematics. But before it was even formally announced, the breakthrough had been complicated by the unusual […]
sources.summary_zh: OpenAI's 週二宣佈它已解決數學界傳奇的千禧年大獎問題之一，這本應是個凱旋的時刻。這個成果既是不可否認的成就，也強烈展示了 AI 變革數學的速度有多快。但甚至在正式宣佈之前，這項突破就被不尋常的 […] 給複雜化了。

sources.title: LandingAI 推出搭載 DPT-3 Pro 與 DPT-3 Verity 的 Agentic Document Extraction Gen2 / LandingAI Releases Agentic Document Extraction Gen2 with DPT-3 Pro and DPT-3 Verity
sources.title_zh: LandingAI 推出搭載 DPT-3 Pro 與 DPT-3 Verity 的 Agentic Document Extraction Gen2
sources.title_en: LandingAI Releases Agentic Document Extraction Gen2 with DPT-3 Pro and DPT-3 Verity
sources.title_original: LandingAI Releases Agentic Document Extraction Gen2 with DPT-3 Pro and DPT-3 Verity
sources.summary: LandingAI has shipped Agentic Document Extraction Gen2, a rebuild of its document stack on the DPT-3 model family. Chunks are retired in favor of a document, page and block tree. DPT-3 Pro grounds to the line, DPT-3 Verity grounds to the word with a confidence score, and Parse billing now counts output characters instead of flat pages. Gen1 code will not run against Gen2 endpoints. The post LandingAI Releases Agentic Document Extraction Gen2 with DPT-3 Pro and DPT-3 Verity appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: LandingAI 推出了 Agentic Document Extraction Gen2，這是基於 DPT-3 模型系列對其文件堆疊進行的重新建構。系統取消了區塊（chunks），改用文件、頁面和區塊樹（block tree）。DPT-3 Pro 可精確對應至行，DPT-3 Verity 則可精確對應至字並帶有信心分數（confidence score），而 Parse 的計費方式現在改為計算輸出字元數，而非單純按頁計費。Gen1 的程式碼將無法在 Gen2 端點上執行。這篇文章 LandingAI Releases Agentic Document Extraction Gen2 with DPT-3 Pro and DPT-3 Verity 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

sources.title: Google 開源 Mantis：讓程式碼代理程式能夠尋找、重現與修補漏洞的模組化技能工具組 / Google Open-Sources Mantis: A Modular Skills Toolkit That Lets Coding Agents Find, Reproduce and Patch Vulnerabilities

sources.title_en: Google Open-Sources Mantis: A Modular Skills Toolkit That Lets Coding Agents Find, Reproduce and Patch Vulnerabilities
sources.title_original: Google Open-Sources Mantis: A Modular Skills Toolkit That Lets Coding Agents Find, Reproduce and Patch Vulnerabilities
sources.summary: Google has open-sourced Mantis, a stack-agnostic toolkit of security review skills for AI coding agents. It runs the full vulnerability lifecycle: sweep the code, filter false positives, reproduce the bug in a sandbox, patch it, re-attack the patch, then score the risk. Apache 2.0, and documented as demonstration-only. The post Google Open-Sources Mantis: A Modular Skills Toolkit That Lets Coding Agents Find, Reproduce and Patch Vulnerabilities appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: Google 已開源 Mantis，這是一套適用於 AI 程式碼代理程式、與堆疊無關的安全審查技能工具組。它能執行完整的漏洞生命週期：掃描程式碼、過濾誤報、在沙箱中重現臭蟲、修補漏洞、重新攻擊修補程式，然後對風險進行評分。採用 Apache 2.0 授權，並記錄為僅供展示使用。本文原標題為 Google Open-Sources Mantis: A Modular Skills Toolkit That Lets Coding Agents Find, Reproduce and Patch Vulnerabilities，載於 MarkTechPost。

sources.summary: Students who use AI to help them study tend to perform worse at school than those who don't, according to data from a global OECD educational report. The situation is more complex than it sounds though, with certain types of AI use giving learners a slight boost, especially among students taught to critically assess how […]

sources.title_en: Qwen opens a 2.4T model to self-hosting, with 95B active parameters
sources.title_original: Qwen opens a 2.4T model to self-hosting, with 95B active parameters
sources.summary: The Alibaba Cloud model activates 95B parameters per token, supports adjustable reasoning depth and offers a self-hosted alternative to OpenAI's GPT-5.5 Pro.
sources.summary_zh: 阿里巴巴 Cloud 模型每個 token 會啟用 950 億（95B）個參數，支援可調整的推理深度，並為 OpenAI's GPT-5.5 Pro 提供自架（self-hosted）的替代方案。
